Class GymCenterDAOImpl

java.lang.Object
com.flipfit.dao.GymCenterDAOImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
GymCenterDAO
public class GymCenterDAOImpl extends Object implements GymCenterDAO
The Class GymCenterDAOImpl. This class provides database operations related to Gym Center management such as: - Adding new gym centers - Fetching centers by owner - Fetching approved centers by city - Approving gym centers
